about: One-item rounds for the formats the larger examples only imply. `honest` lists the rounds that must PASS; each copy is a *-broken folder where the seller applied the wrong rule or ignored a top-up, which must FAIL on the checks listed.

honest.name: second-price
honest.story: One item, the winner pays the highest losing bid (Vickrey).

honest.name: first-price
honest.story: One item, the winner pays their own bid.

honest.name: top-up
honest.story: One item, first price. Alice pays 3,000,000 and later 3,000,000 more under the same memo, so her bid is 6,000,000.

copies.name: second-price-broken
copies.story: The seller charges the second-price winner their whole bid, 3,000,000, and sends no change, instead of the highest losing bid, 1,500,000.

copies.name: first-price-broken
copies.story: The seller charges the first-price winner only the highest losing bid, 1,500,000, instead of their own bid, 3,000,000.

copies.name: top-up-broken
copies.story: The seller counts only the first of Alice's two payments, so her bid looks like 3,000,000 instead of 6,000,000.
